registration.title: New clubs move faster
registration.what: A club with little history takes a bigger step after each match.
registration.why: Clubs with under ten matches are predicted too flat.
registration.how: The step is multiplied by a boost that fades as a club's matches build up.
registration.hypothesis: A faster step for new clubs improves the matches they play.

expected.evidence: The final period had been looked at by earlier diagnostics, so this is strong historical evidence and not a blind test.

registration.success_criteria: The research round's bar (experiments/research_frame/REGISTER.md): better by 0.002 on the final period, the 99.6% interval excluding zero, Brier agreeing, better in 2024/25 and 2025/26, no goal market worse by 0.0005, and 60% of competitions no worse.

events.label: Selection window
events.meaningful: The figure the setting was chosen on.

events.label: Final period
events.meaningful: Real and small, mostly in cups. A fifth of the bar.

events.reason: A real gain below the bar. Slowing the opponent's step, which a fuller uncertainty model would do, made things worse.

events.note: Not released at its own setting: it is part of MC-0016, whose setting for the two together was released as MC-0028 on the owner's decision of 2026-10-14. Its live tracking (P15) closed with that release.
Live at MC-0016's setting for movers and new clubs together (boost 0.5 over 40 matches), released in the club rank as MC-0028 on 2026-10-14; not at its own setting.
